pr_title: Support point in time cross cluster search
pr_body:
This commit integrates point in time into cross cluster search.

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/61827/commits/0a99df6e9a3cf1834b19e23bc9f2076358ab94ed -> Closes #61790
Relates #61062
pr_comments:
Thanks for testing and digging into things @ywangd ! These two are bugs for sure.

On the first point, about open-point-in-time requests that contain only remote indices, I think the fix should be simple add `OpenPointInTimeRequest` to the list in `IndicesAndAliasesResolver#allowsRemoteIndices` .

The other one should also be easy to fix, I would start from https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/cbbe2d7c9c1fabfaa35cc236a3cace2429183427/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/search/TransportSearchAction.java#L294 . Regular searches can have an empty list for "local indices" .

Can you take it home and raise the fix PRs as well ?

> Can you take it home and raise the fix PRs as well ?
>
I am happy to raise a following PR once this one is merged if that's what you are asking.
@ywangd Thank you for reviewing. I've pushed the fix for NPE in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/61827/commits/f83433bbca3640d23dd8b988d5646553dc3b334b.

> @ywangd Thank you for reviewing. I've pushed the fix for NPE in [f83433b](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/commit/f83433bbca3640d23dd8b988d5646553dc3b334b).

@dnhatn Thanks for fixing the NPE. I'll raise follow-up one to fix the permission issue when target indices are all remote.
